comment: overflow: hidden with rounded corners clips the children to the inner curve of the padding box: circle, ellipse, with a border, with padding (the children are clipped at the padding box, inside of it), scaled radii. Tolerance: the anti-aliased edge of a curve where it is nearly tangent to a pixel row or column: the engine fades it linearly over 1.1 px (feathering over 4x multisampling), Skia uses the covered area; such pixels differ by up to about 30 levels (scattered single pixels, no shape difference). The children are clipped by the stencil along the same curve (4 samples, no fade): their edge pixels take one of five coverage levels. Measured 0.309 % on glcore and Vulkan; the cluster limit stays at the default (16 px).
